notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
- The true ending will now be displayed at the top of the save screen once unlocked

- Prologue scenes can now be reviewed in the gallery

- Building exploration/repair events can now be reviewed in the gallery

- Fixed pixel map display issue in 21:9 fullscreen mode

- Skipping scenes now unlocks CGs in the gallery

- New Gallery: "Outings & Photoshoots" section added

- New Gallery: Animated H-scenes – allows direct access to training/live H-scenes from this page

- Rewind/Fast-forward: Use left/right arrow keys and Ctrl key to rewind or fast-forward stream scenes in the gallery

- Fixed issue with skip-read function

- Gallery → Animated H-scenes → Stream: streams now skip intro animations
